name: Arimura Noa
source:
Flaw: No commitment to anything

‘I’ll accept all job offers made.
That’s all I can really do anyway.’

3rd year high-school student. He’s always smiling for some reason, and it’s hard to tell what he’s thinking. A ‘multi-actor’ who will accept all jobs give to him, no matter what it is. Has no sense of taste, and is severely sleep deprived. He attends the same high-school as his childhood friends, [url=/c42608]Rei[/url] and [url=/c42609]Tougo[/url].

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2016/01/17/blackish-house-introduction-2/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
